scope: complete m49 production diff including new store/image.go, dependencies, apps adapters, deploy guard, operator rollout and predeploy handling
assessment: Image validation rejects inputs over 512 bytes before parser work; parser regexes are package-level and no DNS/network request is added. Digest suffix prevalidation repeats a bounded digest parse deliberately to preserve the named short-digest refusal.

Source and deploy validation remain before persistent mutations. Existing external/internal creation boundaries each validate their own contract; no new inventory precheck or extra remote read was added.
Operator changes reuse existing namespace/selector-limited pod scans and reduce malformed-image retry work. Revision/container/deletion checks are constant-time per candidate.
Predeploy keeps existing Job UID selection and delete-before-fail cleanup. No new broad scan, persistent cache, listener, or repeated no-op update was introduced.
